 This Appeal, Coming On For Final Hearing, This Day,
The Court Delivered The Following:
 Judgment

The appeal is filed by the Insurance Company challenging the judgment and award dated 21.06.2011 in M.V.C.No.100/2009 by the learned Senior Civil Judge and M.A.C.T., Gangavathi, contending that the deceased has also contributed negligence to the accident and the determination of compensation made by the Tribunal is on higher side.
2. The factum of the accident and deceased died and insurance coverage are not disputed.

3. Heard the arguments and perused the records.
4.
The deceased while travelling in auto rickshaw met with the accident as the auto rickshaw was dashed by the tipper lorry.
Due to which, the deceased died in the accident.
Under these circumstances, the deceased being passenger in auto rickshaw, she is not at all responsible for the accident.

The Tribunal while answering issue No.1 held that the driver of tipper lorry was completely rash NC: 2023:KHC-D:10877 and negligent in driving tipper lorry and dashed to the auto rickshaw and deceased died, when the deceased was a passenger of the auto rickshaw.
Upon re-appreciating the evidence on record, it is proved that the deceased died while proceeding in the auto rickshaw hit by the tipper lorry to the auto rickshaw.
Therefore, there is no negligence on part of the auto rickshaw driver.
Therefore, the said contention of the insurance company is proved merit less.

5. The Tribunal has awarded compensation under various heads are as follows:
1. Loss of dependency Rs.3,60,000 2. Loss of estate Rs.20,000 3. Loss of love and affection Rs.3,000 United India Insurance Co. Ltd vs Shivkumar Tadasad S/O Late ...

4. Funeral expenses Rs.5,000 Total Rs.3,88,000 6.
The Tribunal has held parameters is on lesser side and awarded the compensation, but the claimant has not preferred any appeal.
If the claimant has preferred an appeal, then there is scope for making enhanced of NC: 2023:KHC-D:10877 compensation.
But the claimant has not filed any appeal.
Therefore, upon considering parameters considered by the Tribunal for assessment of compensation are found to be just and proper.
Therefore, on quantum also the appellant/Insurance Company does not have case on its merit.
On these point, the appeal filed by the Insurance company is liable to be dismissed.

Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER
The appeal is dismissed.
The amount in deposit shall be refunded to the Insurance Company.

SD/-
